title: Cotelligent Flexi Benefits — How to Apply Reimbursements on ZOHO

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Cotelligent offers a Flexible Benefits Plan (FBP) that allows associates to structure their compensation by claiming reimbursements for eligible expenses. These reimbursements are processed through the ZOHO HR system. Associates must submit claims within the defined deadlines to ensure timely reimbursement.

sections.title: How to Submit Reimbursement Claims on ZOHO
paragraphs: To submit a reimbursement claim on ZOHO: Log in to the ZOHO People portal using your official credentials. Navigate to the 'Reimbursement' or 'Claims' section from the main dashboard. Click on 'New Claim' or 'Add Expense'. Select the appropriate expense category (e.g., Mobile/Phone Bill, Food Coupons, Driver Salary, NPS Contribution). Enter the claim amount and the period for which you are claiming. Upload the supporting documents (original bills, receipts, or declarations). Submit the claim for manager approval.
After manager approval, the claim is forwarded to the HR and payroll team for processing. Approved claims are reimbursed in the monthly payroll.

sections.title: Submission Deadlines
paragraphs: Reimbursement claims must be submitted in ZOHO by the 25th of each month to be processed in the same month's payroll. Claims submitted after the 25th will be processed in the following month's payroll.
Annual claims (for the full financial year) must be submitted before the deadline communicated by the HR team, typically in February or March.

sections.title: Supporting Documents Required
paragraphs: Original bills or receipts must be submitted for all reimbursement claims. For Mobile/Phone reimbursement: monthly phone bill in the associate's name. For Driver Salary: salary slip or receipt signed by the driver along with a declaration. For Food Coupons: no bills required; declaration of usage suffices. For NPS: contribution statement from the NPS account.
Documents must be scanned and uploaded clearly. Illegible or incomplete documents will result in claim rejection. Physical copies may be required for auditing purposes as directed by the HR team.

sections.title: Eligible Reimbursement Categories
paragraphs: The following categories are eligible under the Flexi Benefits Plan: Mobile/Phone Bill Reimbursement (up to Rs. 3,000 per month), Driver Salary Reimbursement (up to Rs. 30,000 per month), Food Coupons/Meal Allowance (up to Rs. 2,000 per month), National Pension Scheme (NPS) contributions.
The maximum annual limits for each category are defined in the Flexi Benefit allocation shared with the associate at the time of joining or during annual salary revision.

sections.title: Important Notes
paragraphs: Reimbursements are non-taxable up to the prescribed limits under the Income Tax Act. Amounts claimed beyond the eligible limit will be treated as taxable income. Associates must not claim reimbursements for expenses incurred by others or for personal expenses not covered under the policy.
Fraudulent claims will be treated as misconduct and are subject to disciplinary action including recovery of the claimed amount and termination.
